title.zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会通过稳定币兑换税及加密资产退出税修正案后否决预算收入部分
title.en: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill

current_state.zh: 法国国民议会全体会议已以一票优势通过取消加密兑MiCA稳定币税收递延的2027年预算修正案，拟自2027年1月1日起将此类兑换视为应税处置；此前财政委员会还通过31.4%税率、自托管钱包超10万欧元申报和加密退出税等修正案，但预算收入部分曾被否决；目前措施仍处国民议会一读阶段，尚未成为法律，后续需参议院审议，预计10月20日和11月17日分别投票。
current_state.en: France's full National Assembly has passed by a single vote a 2027 budget amendment removing tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions, treating them as taxable disposals from January 1, 2027; the finance committee had also adopted a 31.4% rate, self-custody reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, while rejecting the revenue section; the measures remain in first reading, are not law, and still require Senate review, with votes expected Oct. 20 and Nov. 17.

updates.title_zh: 法国议员支持在2027年预算法案中对稳定币兑换征税
updates.title_en: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会批准了一项2027年预算法案修正案，将从2027年1月1日起把加密货币兑换为稳定币视为资本利得事件并征税，同时将针对未实现收益的退出税扩大至家庭持有量超过80万欧元并移居海外的加密投资者。
updates.what_changed_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved an amendment to the 2027 budget bill that would tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps as capital gains events starting January 1, 2027, and extend the exit tax on unrealized gains to crypto investors with household holdings above €800,000 relocating abroad.

updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved an amendment to the 2027 budget bill that would tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps as capital gains events starting January 1, 2027, and extend the exit tax on unrealized gains to crypto investors with household holdings above €800,000 relocating abroad.

updates.detailed_summary_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved an amendment to the 2027 budget bill that would tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps as capital gains events starting January 1, 2027, and extend the exit tax on unrealized gains to crypto investors with household holdings above €800,000 relocating abroad.

updates.title_zh: 法国委员会支持稳定币兑换税和加密资产退出税，随后否决预算案
updates.title_en: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会批准了对加密资产兑换为稳定币征税的修正案，并对富裕家庭征收加密资产退出税，随后否决了预算案的全部收入部分，将政府原始文本提交议会审议。
updates.what_changed_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps and impose a crypto exit tax on wealthy households, then rejected the budget's entire revenue section, sending the government's original text to the floor.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会批准了对加密资产兑换为稳定币征税的修正案，并对富裕家庭征收加密资产退出税，随后否决了预算案的全部收入部分，将政府原始文本提交议会审议。
updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps and impose a crypto exit tax on wealthy households, then rejected the budget's entire revenue section, sending the government's original text to the floor.

updates.title_zh: 法国议员支持对超过11.2万美元的加密钱包实施申报规则
updates.title_en: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会还通过了一项修正案（I-CF821），要求持有价值10万欧元及以上自托管加密资产的人每年申报持仓，未申报最高罚款1万欧元。
updates.what_changed_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee also adopted an amendment (I-CF821) requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过五项加密相关修正案（包括稳定币互换税、加密出境税和自托管钱包申报），随后否决了预算的收入部分；这些加密修正案需在议会辩论中重新提交才能成为法律。
updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee has adopted five crypto-related amendments (including a stablecoin swap tax, crypto exit tax, and self-custody wallet reporting), then rejected the budget's revenue section; the crypto amendments must be resubmitted during parliamentary debate to become law.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: French lawmakers on the National Assembly's Finance Committee backed an amendment requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report those holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.
updates.detailed_summary_en: French lawmakers on the National Assembly's Finance Committee backed an amendment requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report those holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.

updates.title_zh: 法国拟对受监管稳定币征税，可能促使加密交易者转向离岸
updates.title_en: Proposed French tax on regulated stablecoins could drive crypto traders offshore
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增事实：法国财政委员会另于10月7日通过允许加密损失结转最多10年的修正案；Chainalysis法国CEO警告31.4%稳定币税可能推动交易转向不受监管的离岸稳定币；议会需在12月10日前通过2027年预算。
updates.what_changed_en: New facts: a separate Oct. 7 amendment backed by the finance committee would allow crypto losses to be carried forward up to 10 years; Chainalysis' France CEO warned the 31.4% regulated-stablecoin tax could push trading toward unregulated offshore stablecoins; lawmakers have until Dec. 10 to pass the 2027 budget.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过2027年预算中多项加密税收修正案，包括将加密兑MiCA稳定币按31.4%资本利得征税、自托管钱包持有10万欧元以上年度申报、扩大退出税及允许加密损失结转10年；委员会随后以31票对3票否决预算收入部分，修正案需重新提交国民议会全体审议，收入部分预计10月20日投票，预算需在12月10日前通过，目前均未成为法律。
updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly finance committee has adopted multiple crypto tax amendments in the 2027 budget, including a 31.4% capital gains tax on crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin swaps, annual reporting for self-custody wallets holding €100,000 or more, an expanded exit tax, and 10-year crypto loss carryforwards; it then rejected the budget's revenue section 31-3. The amendments must be resubmitted to the full National Assembly, a revenue vote is expected Oct. 20, and the budget must pass by Dec. 10; no measure is yet law.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: French lawmakers introduced a proposal to tax crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin swaps at the 31.4% capital gains rate starting January 2027, alongside a €100,000 self-hosted wallet disclosure rule and an extended exit tax, drawing warnings that traders could migrate to unregulated offshore channels.
updates.detailed_summary_en: French lawmakers introduced a proposal to tax crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin swaps at the 31.4% capital gains rate starting January 2027, alongside a €100,000 self-hosted wallet disclosure rule and an extended exit tax, drawing warnings that traders could migrate to unregulated offshore channels.

updates.title_zh: 法国考虑自 2027 年起对加密资产转换为 MiCA 稳定币征收 31.4% 的税
updates.title_en: France Considers 31.4% Tax on Crypto-to-MiCA Stablecoin Conversions From 2027
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增具体税率：法国2027年预算修正案拟对加密货币兑换为MiCA监管稳定币征收31.4%资本利得税；财政委员会以31票对3票否决政府收入部分；预计10月20日就收入部分进行投票；目前尚无任何措施成为法律。
updates.what_changed_en: Adds the specific 31.4% capital gains tax rate on crypto-to-MiCA-regulated-stablecoin conversions in France's 2027 budget amendment; the finance committee rejected the government's revenue section by 31 votes to 3; a revenue vote is expected Oct. 20; no measure is law yet.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过包括31.4%加密兑MiCA稳定币税、自托管钱包超10万欧元申报和加密退出税在内的修正案，随后以31票对3票否决预算收入部分；这些修正案退回国民议会全体审议，收入部分预计10月20日投票，目前均未成为法律。
updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee has adopted amendments including a 31.4% crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin tax, self-custody wallet reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, then rejected the budget's revenue section 31-3; the amendments return to the full National Assembly, with a revenue vote expected Oct. 20 and no measure yet law.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: France's parliament is reviewing a 2027 budget amendment that would impose a 31.4% capital gains tax on crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions from January 2027, alongside proposals to declare self-custodied wallets above €100k and include crypto in the exit tax, with a revenue vote expected Oct. 20 and no measure yet law.
updates.detailed_summary_en: France's parliament is reviewing a 2027 budget amendment that would impose a 31.4% capital gains tax on crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions from January 2027, alongside proposals to declare self-custodied wallets above €100k and include crypto in the exit tax, with a revenue vote expected Oct. 20 and no measure yet law.

updates.title_zh: 【法国国民议会以一票优势通过加密货币兑换稳定币征税修正案】
updates.title_en: 【法国国民议会以一票优势通过加密货币兑换稳定币征税修正案】
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会全体会议以38票赞成、37票反对、25票弃权通过了一项2027年预算修正案，拟从2027年1月1日起取消加密货币兑换为MiCA定义稳定币的税收递延待遇，将其视为应税处置；该修正案仍处一读阶段，尚未成为法律，国民议会预计10月20日对预算第一部分投票、11月17日对整部法案表决。
updates.what_changed_en: France's full National Assembly passed by 38 votes to 37, with 25 abstentions, a 2027 budget amendment that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-defined-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable disposals; the amendment remains in first reading and is not law, with the Assembly expected to vote on the budget's first part Oct. 20 and the whole bill Nov. 17.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会全体会议已以一票优势通过取消加密兑MiCA稳定币税收递延的2027年预算修正案，拟自2027年1月1日起将此类兑换视为应税处置；此前财政委员会还通过31.4%税率、自托管钱包超10万欧元申报和加密退出税等修正案，但预算收入部分曾被否决；目前措施仍处国民议会一读阶段，尚未成为法律，后续需参议院审议，预计10月20日和11月17日分别投票。
updates.current_state_en: France's full National Assembly has passed by a single vote a 2027 budget amendment removing tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions, treating them as taxable disposals from January 1, 2027; the finance committee had also adopted a 31.4% rate, self-custody reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, while rejecting the revenue section; the measures remain in first reading, are not law, and still require Senate review, with votes expected Oct. 20 and Nov. 17.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: France's National Assembly passed by a single vote an amendment to the 2027 budget that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable capital-gains events even without fiat conversion.
updates.detailed_summary_en: France's National Assembly passed by a single vote an amendment to the 2027 budget that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable capital-gains events even without fiat conversion.
